summary: Implemented the ADR 0005/0009 deterministic serializer, typed zone-aware CanonicalStore, full ADR 0006 nonce-fenced lock and staged recovery primitives, and concurrency-safe user-level context registry with comprehensive failure-injection tests and documentation.
behavior_implemented: Added byte-deterministic UTF-8/LF YAML, JSON, and Markdown serialization with declaration-order model fields, recursively sorted free-form mappings, ADR 0009 null/omit behavior, shared frontmatter parsing, golden bytes, and exact hand-edit detection.
Added a typed CanonicalStore for context configs, entities, tasks, and artifact manifests with explicit context-zone, suffix, identity, traversal, nested-context, symlink, and junction boundaries.
Implemented exclusive nonce lock acquisition, atomic heartbeat, stale takeover with preserved evidence, fencing, bounded PermissionError handling, and a crash-recoverable file-only mutation guard.

Implemented fsynced staged postimages and preimage backups, a durable ordered intent, exact hash and fence checks on every retry, completion and rollback recovery, audit-gated finalizers, and read-only recovery classification.

Added sorted and idempotent user registry APIs with explicit active selection, atomic persistence, duplicate-key rejection, crash-released advisory locking, and rejection of storage inside any context.
Routed the private context bootstrap writer through the canonical serializer without changing frozen public signatures and documented the complete WP-200-owned runtime layout.

tests.result: Success: no issues found in 38 source files

assumptions: The operator's explicit assignment authorized execution on the supplied ready branch at a066d87, a direct child of the contract-declared cf9ebab base.
The Codex-managed physical worktree was the assigned worktree because it used the required agent/WP-200-canonical-store branch.
Local NTFS semantics are covered directly; POSIX directory fsync remains best effort and SMB/NFS receive no stronger Phase 1 guarantee.
decisions: Use unique Lamport bakery choosing/ticket files under owned 98_state/staging to serialize all lock.json mutations without a SQLite or third-party correctness dependency.
Retire persistently unremovable unique guard artifacts with per-artifact cancellation markers and reap guard-before-marker when availability returns.
Retain transaction-local preimage backups and reconstruct consumed postimages atomically so interrupted rollback remains resumable.
Keep a successful intent durable until the future WP-300 audit workflow invokes the appropriate verified finalizer.
Keep caller-supplied registry paths for isolated configurations and tests while enforcing that every such path resolves outside all context roots.
deviations: The supplied branch started at a066d87 rather than the contract-declared cf9ebab; a066d87 is the lead-owned Wave 2 activation/status commit, and the worker implementation is isolated in d664f73 for review or cherry-pick.
The physical Codex-managed worktree path differs from the nominal .worktrees/WP-200-canonical-store path while the required branch was used.
No objective, architecture, frozen-signature, dependency, or worker-owned path deviation was made.
security_considerations: Canonical, runtime, and registry paths fail closed on traversal, absolute paths, unsafe links, reparse points, nested contexts, cross-zone resolution, malformed state, and duplicate JSON keys.
Nonce fencing and exact preimage, postimage, and staged-source hashes are revalidated at commit-sensitive points and before every replacement retry.
Stale takeover preserves displaced lock evidence; recovery inspection is non-mutating and unsafe or dangling intent leaves are invalid rather than clean.
Fixtures are fictional; no secrets, network access, SQLite paths, CLI wiring, or external writes were introduced.
migration_considerations: This is an additive schema-version-1 adapter and runtime layout with no canonical data migration.
Domain models, public schemas, CLI presentation, SQLite projections, and the audit representation remain unchanged.
98_state/backups remains reserved for the ADR 0007 migration flow and WP-200 creates no migration archives.
unresolved: The lead should reconcile or explicitly accept the cf9ebab versus a066d87 administrative base boundary during integration; there are no implementation blockers.
recommended_next_action: Lead review d664f73 and the report commit, resolve the administrative base boundary, re-run the full validation gate, and integrate WP-200 for WP-210/WP-300 consumers.
